Figure 2:Weight programs install new capabilities and keep existing behavior.(a) SCAN (a new verb in known compositions; a new combination of known words) and BabyAI before and after the program, with the weights each changes; gray, a rule-to-data reference trained on commands generated from the grammar (SCAN) and the best behavior cloning kept by the retention rule (BabyAI).
(b) ImageNet ResNet-18: top-1 under corruption (95% intervals), net gain, and the change in clean top-1 on held-out ImageNet and on ImageNetV2; dashed red, the clean bound of the success criterion.
(c) Net gain of every CIFAR-10 program, 10 of 12 above the best kept fine-tuning on its network; light bars, programs that do not meet the prespecified comparative criterion; diamonds, fine-tuning without the retention rule.
Held-out test sets.
